news.title: Michael Burry says he's still betting against Palantir after Trump post boosts stock

news.title: How bond market's private credit crisis fears are playing out in fixed-income ETFs
news.summary: Fears of a private credit crisis arrived just as the growing and less transparent bond market was being included in more fixed-income ETFs.

news.title: Goldman Sachs tops estimates on record equities trading
news.summary: Goldman Sachs posted record equities trading revenue for the first quarter, helping propel the overall firm to its second-highest quarterly revenue.

news.title: China exports growth in March misses estimates, imports surge most in over four years
news.summary: China's export growth slowed in March as manufacturers grappled with surging energy costs, with the Iran war disrupting supplies, while imports jumped more than expected.
